name: S4
description: The Audi S4 (1991–present) is the mid-performance A4 variant, slotting below the RS4. The original B5 S4 with its twin-turbocharged 2.7-litre V6 is a cult car; the B8/B9 generations use supercharged/turbocharged V6 engines. The S4 represents the sweet-spot between everyday usability and genuine performance.
